input.quote: 13.6 Independent Development: Covenant not to Sue. Nothing in this Agreement will be construed to prohibit either parties' right to independently develop the Developments contemplated above.
input.rationale: No non-compete or competing-product covenant binds Corio anywhere in the Agreement. Section 2.7 (p0042) is a conventional license-scope/reverse-engineering restriction, not a restraint on our business; Section 13.6 (p0117) expressly preserves each party's right to develop independently, and Section 14.8 (p0131) confirms Corio solely directs and may subcontract the Corio Services. The Territory (North America, expandable under Section 2.10) and Corio Market Segment (<$1B customers, with carve-outs in Section 1.3) are limits on the scope of the licenses granted to us rather than prohibitions on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, so they do not amount to a field-of-use non-compete on Customer. This meets the preferred position; no redline needed.
